secondary.note: laying-points correction; hypothesis found after looking at tuning data; pre-declared secondary for the 2025 holdout, not retuned

preregistered_2025.1_k_weeks4plus: k for weeks 4+ pooled, re-estimated on 2025 (game bootstrap, 1,000 draws), > 0 with the 95% CI excluding 0
preregistered_2025.2_clv: CLV at |proj - open| >= 1.5: the close moves toward the model in >= 58% of the games where it moves
preregistered_2025.3_calibration: 75-90% band, |actual - predicted| <= 2.0 pts, separately for getting-points and laying-points rungs (primary model)
preregistered_2025.3b_secondary_rule: if laying-points misses, the secondary is adopted only if its log loss beats the primary's on 2025 laying-points rungs: the fixed set of (game, side, x.5 rung < 0) pairs that EITHER model puts in [75%, 90%), each pair scored under both models
preregistered_2025.4_ats: ATS vs open and vs close: informational only
